item.name: Gray-Water IBC
item.readyBeforeUse: The container is below its marked full line and has no visible leak.
item.readyForNextPerson: All wastewater is contained. The access point is closed. No liquid is present outside the container or on the playa.
item.ifNotReady: Do not add wastewater. Tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: The liquid reaches the marked full line.
problem.response: Do not add wastewater. Tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: The container or connection is leaking.
problem.response: Stop using it and tell the Dominatrix.
